entries.31cd3976dad1330e: This reportable segment provides neutral and fair electricity network services. The company's general transmission and distribution business and its power generation and other businesses on remote islands were succeeded by Tohoku Electric Power Network Co., Ltd. through an absorption-type company split in April 2020. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥476,702 million. Revenue before elimination of internal transactions was ¥921.3 billion, a decrease of ¥24.5 billion (2.6%) from the previous period. Although revenue from standard wheeling charges rose owing to revisions to unit wheeling charges, revenue from supply-demand adjustment fell, among other factors. Area electricity demand was 75.2 billion kWh, roughly the same as the previous period. As initiatives, the company is pursuing efficiency measures in response to rising prices and other factors, reducing procurement costs for adjustment capacity, efficiently building, renewing and operating transmission and distribution facilities, and strengthening cooperation with local governments and disaster prevention organizations.
